description: Return a MoonPay URL for selling ETH or USDC from wallet_address for fiat paid to the user's card or bank, in two calls like create_moonpay_buy_link. The user confirms the sale on MoonPay; then get_moonpay_sell_transaction gives the deposit address and amount to send. Live or sandbox per this server's configuration: the result's environment says which, and real_payment is true only for live checkouts.

base_currency_amount.description: Amount of crypto to sell in whole units, e.g. 0.05 or 100, not base units or wei; MoonPay enforces its own minimum and maximum. Omit to let the user choose

currency_code.description: Crypto to sell, as MoonPay's code: eth or usdc on Ethereum, or eth_base, usdc_base, eth_arbitrum, usdc_arbitrum. MoonPay does not buy back on Optimism. Sandbox offers only eth and usdc on Sepolia

quote_currency_code.description: Fiat currency the user is paid out in; default usd

wallet_address.description: EVM address that holds the crypto being sold and sends it to MoonPay; MoonPay refunds a failed sale here

name: create_moonpay_sell_link
title: Create a MoonPay sell (off-ramp) link
